push notification.note: Existing rendering اعلان‌های پوش; پوش is the accepted transliteration for push in Persian mobile UI.

share extension.note: No existing fa; follows plugin/extension = افزونه and share = اشتراک‌گذاری.

bottom sheet.note: No established Persian term; mostly appears in accessibility strings.

swipe.note: Google's Persian Android convention is تند کشیدن; plain کشیدن (e.g. کشیدن به چپ) reads naturally in instructions.

long-press.note: Verb phrase: به‌مدت طولانی فشار دهید (Google Android fa convention).

tap.note: Imperative: ضربه بزنید (Google Android fa convention).

toast.note: No established Persian term; describes the brief confirmation overlay.

clipboard.note: Existing rendering (رونوشت در حافظه موقت for 'copied to clipboard').

passcode.note: Device numeric lock code; keep distinct from password = رمز عبور.

jailbroken.note: Existing fa uses جیلبریک; rooted (Android) = روت‌شده.

app logs.note: No existing mobile fa; گزارش for log. Note the desktop fa file renders logs as ردپا — do not carry that into mobile.

deep link.note: Google Android fa convention; دیپ‌لینک also common colloquially.

skin tone.note: Existing rendering for emoji skin tones; avoid the mistranslation رنگ پوسته (theme skin) seen in one string.

server connection.note: Add a server: افزودن سرور (existing: افزودن یک سرور); Switch server: تغییر سرور.
